The role ensures that the company's Quality Management System is effectively implemented and that construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, applicable codes, standards, and company procedures. Review and approve Project Quality Plans, ITPs, procedures, inspection checklists, and quality strategies. Monitor site quality control activities, inspections, material compliance, testing, and workmanship. Review major and recurring NCRs and ensure proper Root Cause Analysis, Corrective Actions, and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Monitor quality KPIs, trends, audit findings, NCRs, defects, and rework across all projects. Lead internal quality audits and oversee preparation for Client, Consultant, and external audits. Strong knowledge of NCR management, Root Cause Analysis, Corrective and Preventive Actions, and quality audits. Strong understanding of project specifications, contracts, drawings, codes, and construction methodologies. Skills: Excellent leadership, strategic planning, decision-making, and organizational skills. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to manage QA/QC functions across multiple projects simultaneously. Strong analytical capability with the ability to identify trends and convert quality data into improvement actions.
